results.llm_raw: {"say":"The live delivery line merges two parallel miner runs into a balancer but never cuts, so I convert that 2-wide pair in place into the cutter the recipe requires.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B63","B64"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"}]},"why":"These two parallel belts feed the same balancer entry; replacing both cells with one cutter inserts the cut step on the live path instead of the dead cutter branch."}]}

{"say":"Nothing currently cuts the mined ore into the RuRu---- half before it reaches the hub; the recipe requires one cutter, so I'll insert it into the visible miner output run.","calls":[{"macro":"insert_machine","args":{"at":{"$ref":"B112","asCell":true},"facing":"top","machine":"cutter","opts":{"replace_belts":true}},"why":"M3 pushes uncut RuRuRuRu up this belt run toward the trunk; placing the required cutter here converts it to the goal half-shape (waste side discarded) before it can reach the hub."}]}

{"say":"The two parallel ore lanes feeding L3 carry whole ore, so I turn their footprint into a cutter with a waste trash on the right, leaving the kept half to run on to the hub line.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B105","B97","B90","B81","B69","B63","B106","B98","B91","B82","B70","B64"]},"building":[{"kind":"cutter"},{"kind":"trash","port":"right"}]},"why":"Both runs feed L3 side by side, so one 2-wide region can hold the cutter; ore gets cut and the right (waste) half goes straight into the trash."}]}

{"say":"The cutter's waste half (left output B84) has no trash to dump into, so the cutter backs up and nothing reaches the hub; convert that waste run into a trash so the kept half can flow.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B84"]},"building":[{"kind":"trash","port":"right"}]},"why":"C1 cutter needs its waste output destroyed so it does not clog and the kept half (B85) can be delivered"}]}

{"say":"The cutter's waste half (its right output run) is not being discarded, so I convert that waste belt into a trash so only the kept half can be delivered.","calls":[{"macro":"replace_run","args":{"region":{"$path_of":["B85"]},"building":[{"kind":"trash","port":"right"}]},"why":"B85 is the cutter's right (waste) output; trashing it locally is the documented cutter+waste pattern and stops the wrong half polluting delivery."}]}
